pattern.description: In the fixed chat panel the AI agent's long order-status reply arrives as one bubble from below and the whole conversation scrolls up until the reply fills the visible area, the earlier messages clipping out at the top.
pattern.why_premium: A single smooth, continuous scroll delivers a long answer legibly in one beat, mimicking a real chat client while staying synced with the narration ('responding intuitively').

build_hint.gsap: Clipped chat body: gsap.from(answerBubble, {y: 60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out'}) then gsap.to(chatStack, {y: '-=330', duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.inOut'}) overlapping at '<0.1'; no stagger on lines.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 18], [0, -330], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) on the message list in an overflow-hidden container; bubble opacity interpolate(frame, [0, 6], [0, 1]).

notes: Could be read as ai_answer_stream, but the reply appears as a whole bubble and scrolls rather than streaming line by line, so masked_scroll fits better. b03 covers the customer bubble's remaining bottom edge plus timestamp. Chime vs music for x012/x013 is uncertain.
